description: This file defines the 'UnixSocketConnectionListener' class, which implements 'IConnectionListener' to manage Unix domain socket listening, accepting connections, and resource disposal within the Orleans testing host framework.

classes.name: UnixSocketConnectionListener
classes.description: A class that listens on a Unix domain socket, accepts incoming connections, and manages their lifecycle within the Orleans testing infrastructure.

methods.name: UnixSocketConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket listener with endpoint, options, tracing, and scheduler configurations.

methods.name: EndPoint
methods.description: Property to retrieve the endpoint associated with the listener.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Configures and binds the listening socket to the Unix domain socket endpoint, then starts listening for connections.

methods.name: AcceptAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously accepts incoming connection requests and wraps accepted sockets into connection objects.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the listening socket.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Dispose of the socket and associated resources, effectively unbinding the listener.
